summary: Iter 14 (Droit AI artifact + <SEND> tag, voice overlay, home extension badges + long-press action sheet + PDF filter, legal screen, profile version, Droit chat UI, create/upload-existing, viewer pointer, scanner) — Backend 9/9 pytest PASS after fixing one real bug in ai_workspace.py (Droit <SEND> handler was inserting a document missing updated_at + several DocumentOut required fields, causing GET /api/documents/received to return 500 for the recipient). Backend now: POST /api/aiw/chat 'Generate … PDF' → artifact.download_id + name returned; GET /api/downloads/{id}/file → 200 %PDF; second turn 'send it to bob@bachein.com' → sent_to='bob@bachein.com' returned + document created and listed in bob's /api/documents/received; DELETE /api/documents/{id} → sender 200 {deleted:true}, non-sender 403, doc gone (GET → 404); POST /api/downloads/import image/png → 200 with download_id + valid PDF fetch; POST /api/viewer/explain (small labeled bbox) → 200 with 'explanation'; POST /api/aiw/voice/say → 200 audio_base64. Frontend (mobile 390x844, alice@bachein.com Test1234!): (1) Home voice orb testID home-voice-orb next to search → tapping opens immersive overlay with data-testid='voice-screen' OVER home (home-screen still in DOM behind blur), 'Tap the orb and start talking' text present; chevron-down (voice-back) closes overlay returning to intact Home. (2) Home doc rows show extension badge '.pdf' after title (verified 'TEST_voice .pdf' in row0). PDF filter chip loads rows (14 rows). (3) Drawer: menu-btn opens drawer → drawer-scroll container present + drawer-terms + drawer-children + drawer-ai-policy + drawer-nda-legal + drawer-profile + drawer-logout all present; tapping drawer-ai-policy navigates to /legal?section=ai → legal-screen renders 'Usage of AI Policy' section; legal-back returns to Home. (4) Profile: app-version testID reads 'Bachein v1.0.0' exactly. (5) AI/chat: input placeholder is 'Ask Droit anything'; assistant header/name renders as 'Droit'; ai-history-btn opens LEFT side drawer with 'Droit' title + New button + list of 17 conversations; sending 'Generate a two-line congratulations note as a PDF titled TEST_iter14_UI' → droit-artifact card appeared in ~5s with artifact-view + artifact-share buttons, name/badge 'Document · PDF'. (6) Regressions: /sign-pdf renders 'Sign Document' + 'Upload a PDF to sign' (no red screen); /scanner renders scanner-screen with scanner-grant permission gate ('Allow camera' + 'Import from gallery instead') no crash; /create/mode?category=Report shows create-mode-screen + mode-upload testID; floating dock tabs Home/Documents/File Kit/AI visible on all screens. ONE UI BUG: on web preview, long-press on home rows does NOT trigger the doc action sheet — mouse.down + 1200ms hold + mouse.up over row0 fires onPress (navigates to /receive/{id}) instead of onLongPress; doc-action-share / doc-action-delete never mount. Native RN behaviour likely fine but web Pressable delayLongPress isn't wired reliably (see index.tsx:332). REACT-NATIVE-WEB WARNING (non-blocking): multiple 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow / textShadow* deprecated. Use textShadow / props.pointerEvents deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents / Image style.resizeMode deprecated. Use props.resizeMode — spread across many screens; RN 0.76+ deprecations, does not break functionality but should be addressed. Also observed a JS 'Uncaught Error: Cannot start audio recording without initializing a MediaRecorder' from voice.tsx:26 when closing the overlay — surfaces as an in-app error dialog on web preview only (main agent notes web headless has no mic; expected but the close path should catch it silently).

minor.issue: FIXED — Droit <SEND email=...> handler was inserting a document without updated_at (and several DocumentOut fields), which caused GET /api/documents/received for the recipient to raise pydantic ValidationError → HTTP 500. Fixed in /app/backend/ai_workspace.py by adding updated_at (same as created_at) + delivered/opened/otp_verified/face_verified/voice_oath_completed/voice_attempts/agreement_read_pct/signature_status. Backfilled 2 pre-existing docs in DB.

ui_bugs.issue: On web preview, long-press on home-row-{id} does not fire onLongPress — even a 1200ms mouse hold triggers onPress (navigation to /receive/{id}) instead of opening the doc action sheet. doc-action-share / doc-action-delete Modal never mounts on web. Native mobile likely unaffected. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:332 (Pressable delayLongPress={350}).

Closing the voice overlay on web triggers an uncaught 'Cannot start audio recording without initializing a MediaRecorder' error dialog. The overlay does close successfully but the error toast/modal appears. Should be caught silently on web (headless has no mic — expected). Reference: /app/frontend/app/voice.tsx around line 26 (close/stopPlayback path).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warnings observed on almost every render: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' deprecated (use textShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), Image 'style.resizeMode' deprecated (use props.resizeMode). Non-blocking but should be migrated across StyleSheet.create() blocks.

action_items: MEDIUM: On web preview, home row Pressable's onLongPress does not fire — action sheet unreachable. Consider adding a right-click/context handler for web, or replace Pressable with GestureDetector/longPressGestureHandler for cross-platform long-press. Users on mobile Expo Go likely work, but web preview flow is blocked.

LOW: /app/frontend/app/voice.tsx stopPlayback close path throws on web (no MediaRecorder). Wrap the stopPlayback / audio cleanup in try/catch and swallow the InvalidStateError on web so the error dialog doesn't appear when the user chevron-down closes without ever having recorded.

LOW: Migrate deprecated RN style props across StyleSheet.create() blocks — shadow* → boxShadow, textShadow* → textShadow, pointerEvents prop → style.pointerEvents, Image style.resizeMode → props.resizeMode.
Optional: also add updated_at to the sent-tag path's returned reply metadata (not strictly needed since /aiw/chat returns sent_to only).
critical_code_review_comments: ai_workspace.py Droit <SEND> handler (line ~559): the inserted document was missing updated_at + all default DocumentOut fields (delivered/opened/otp_verified/…/signature_status). Because DocumentOut requires updated_at, the recipient's GET /api/documents/received raised pydantic ValidationError → 500. Now fixed. Consider centralizing document creation via a helper _new_document(sender, recipient, title, content) used by both POST /documents and the Droit send path to avoid drift.

ai_workspace.py: <DOCUMENT> and <SEND> tags are parsed via regex; if the LLM omits the closing tag or malforms the attribute, the parse silently falls through (no observed issue in this run, but consider logging when a partial tag appears).
server.py DELETE /documents/{id}: correct 403 for non-sender before delete; 404 vs 403 order verified (returns 404 if not found even to non-sender — correct).
downloads_routes.py GET /downloads/{did}/file uses user_flex (token-in-query allowed) — good for Share/View from mobile since local blob URL isn't required.

index.tsx RowCard: onLongPress={onLongPress} delayLongPress={350} — this works on native but react-native-web's Pressable long-press is unreliable when the pointer is not moved. Consider using expo-gesture-handler LongPressGestureHandler for a consistent cross-platform experience.
updated_files: /app/backend/ai_workspace.py (fixed Droit <SEND> handler to include updated_at + full DocumentOut default fields)

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (backend 500 on GET /documents/received after Droit send): ai_workspace.py's <SEND> handler built a partial document dict without updated_at + all optional DocumentOut fields; the endpoint's list comprehension `[DocumentOut(**d) for d in docs]` raises pydantic ValidationError on the first offending doc → HTTP 500. REPRO: alice sends 'Generate short note as PDF' then 'send it to bob@bachein.com' via /api/aiw/chat; bob calls GET /api/documents/received → 500. MITIGATION: (a) code fix — insert full doc dict with updated_at=created_at plus the same defaults used by POST /documents; (b) db backfill — {'updated_at': {'$exists': False}} → set to created_at (2 docs). Both applied. Verified pass on rerun.
